name: ThroneBreaker : Iron Crown
source:
A story-driven adventure filled with intrigue, romance, and betrayal. Every choice shapes your destiny in a kingdom torn by secrets and power. Rule with love or fear—your path to the throne is yours to decide.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4076360/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事驱动的冒险充满了阴谋、浪漫和背叛。在这个被秘密和权力撕裂的王国中，每一个选择都会塑造你的命运。用爱或恐惧来统治——你的王位之路由你决定。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4076360/]Steam[/url]]
